en.t: Tears came to her eyes before she knew it.

units.source_text: 深恐被人看见，努力隐忍。

en.t: Afraid that someone might see, she struggled hard to hold them back.

units.source_text: 但又想：源氏公子那鲜艳夺目的容貌，在天光之下更加昳丽，

en.t: But then she thought: Prince Genji's brilliant, dazzling beauty would be even more radiant in the daylight,

units.source_text: 倘若未曾窥见，岂不可惜！

en.t: and if she never caught a glimpse of it, would that not be a terrible pity!
